name: Idaho

statute.readVia: https://web.archive.org/web/20260610064342/https://legislature.idaho.gov/statutesrules/idstat/Title49/T49CH9/SECT49-944/ (archived copy of the official page; live site unreachable)

windshield.strip: nonreflective tint not below the AS-1 line; if no AS-1 line, not below a line 6 inches below the top of the exposed windshield

frontSide.note: plus or minus 3%; luminous reflectance max 35% (+/-3)

backSide.note: plus or minus 3%; luminous reflectance max 35% (+/-3)

rear.note: plus or minus 3%; luminous reflectance max 35% (+/-3)

tint.measuredHow: not stated (light transmission defined as light passing through 'the product or material')

medicalExemption.text: Driver or passenger with written verification from a licensed physician of medical need to be protected from sunlight or heat may have 70% (+/-3) on the windshield and 20% (+/-3) on the windows; verification must be carried in the vehicle.

quotes: a light transmission of not less than thirty-five percent (35%) with a tolerance limit of plus or minus three percent (3%) ... may be applied to the front side vents, front side windows to the immediate right and left of the driver, and the rear window
a light transmission of not less than twenty percent (20%) with a tolerance limit of plus or minus three percent (3%) ... may be applied to the side windows to the rear of the driver
shall not be applied to the windshield below the AS-1 line; if no AS-1 line is identifiable ... below a line extending six (6) inches below and parallel to the exposed windshield
Any person convicted of a violation of the provisions of this section shall be guilty of an infraction.

helmet.conditions: Riders and operators under 18 (motorcycles, motorbikes, ATVs, UTVs) on public roads

handheldPhone.fineText: first offense $75; second within 3 years $150; third+ $300; no points on first conviction

radarDetector.note: commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: legislature.idaho.gov refused connections; § 49-944 read from a June 2026 Wayback copy of the official page; §§ 49-666, 49-1401A, 49-948 read via codes.findlaw.com ('current as of January 01, 2024').
Infraction fine amount for tint (set by Idaho infraction rules) not found.
No separate rule for SUVs/vans/pickups in § 49-944 (only factory glazing exempt under (5)).
